Supplementary Figure 2: RIG-I-only vs STAT-only signatures in virus-infected single cells (CHIKV and SARS-CoV-2)

Carlos Ramirez

2026-10-27 17:03:46

This markdown reproduces the two panels of Supplementary Figure 2. We project the RIG-I-only and STAT-only (IFN-only) signatures, derived from the A549 cell model in figure_01.Rmd, onto two virus-infection single-cell RNA-Seq datasets by computing per-cell module scores (Seurat::AddModuleScore):

  1. plots_chikv.pdf — human fibroblasts infected with chikungunya virus (CHIKV; Pott F et al., 2021, GEO GSE176361) at 6 and 24 hours post infection (hpi). Top: scatter plot of RIG-I-only vs STAT-only scores per cell, coloured by the viral-RNA level category of the cell (mock, bystander = no_chikv, low_chikv; the high_chikv cells are excluded), with the RIG-I-only = 0.15 threshold used to define “RIG-I-high” cells. Bottom: among RIG-I-high cells, IFNB1 expression (left) and log CHIKV-nsp expression (right) per time point and viral-RNA category (Kruskal-Wallis p-values).
  2. scatterplot_rigi_vs_stat_ravindra.pdf — SARS-CoV-2-infected human bronchial epithelial cells (HBEC air-liquid interface cultures; Ravindra NG et al., 2021, PLoS Biol, GEO GSE166766). RIG-I-only vs STAT-only scores of the SARS-CoV-2-positive cells (scv2+ == 1), coloured by IFNL1 expression and faceted by cell type.

Code is taken from the original analysis scripts (/media/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/interferon_model/scripts/R/july_2026/03_scRNASeq_chinkonkunia_dataset.Rmd and /media/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/interferon_model/scripts/R/july_2026/figure_03_scRNASeq_projections_ravindra.Rmd), keeping only what is needed for these two panels. Plotting code and PDF sizes are unchanged.

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(Seurat)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)

source("/media/bq-storage/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/decoupling_rigi_ifn/scripts/R/settings.R")

Settings

Output folders of this section: PDFs go to figures/supplementary_figure_02/ and intermediate tables to analysis/supplementary_figure_02/ of the repo.

dirs <- section_dirs("supplementary_figure_02")
path2figures  <- dirs$figures
path2analysis <- dirs$analysis

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  error = FALSE
)

Input data

All inputs are read-only; nothing is written next to them.

Input Absolute path Description
Signatures /media/bq-storage/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/decoupling_rigi_ifn/analysis/figure_01/rigi_vs_stat_only_signatures.rds RIG-I-only (94 genes) and STAT-only (99 genes) signatures defined in figure_01.Rmd (identical to /media/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/interferon_model/analysis/2026_May/rigi_vs_stat_only_signatures.rds, used by the original scripts).
CHIKV 6 hpi /media/bq-storage/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/data/GSE176361_chkv_2021/GSE176361_integrated_6hpi.rds Processed, integrated Seurat object from GEO GSE176361 (Pott F et al., 2021; supplementary file GSE176361_integrated_6hpi.rds.gz, already decompressed in the data folder). Contains the SCT assay used for scoring.
CHIKV 24 hpi /media/bq-storage/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/data/GSE176361_chkv_2021/GSE176361_integrated_24hpi.rds As above, 24 hpi (GSE176361_integrated_24hpi.rds.gz).
Ravindra HBEC /media/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/interferon_model/data/ravindra_single_cells_processed/ravindra_processed_seurat.rds Seurat object (raw counts, one counts layer per sample) built in /media/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/interferon_model/scripts/R/08_projecting_single_cells_on_IFN.Rmd from the GEO GSE166766 10x matrices in /media/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/interferon_model/data/ravindra_single_cells/ (GSM5082289_mock, GSM5082290_1dpi, GSM5082291_2dpi, GSM5082292_3dpi), with the cell annotations of Ravindra et al. (/media/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/interferon_model/data/ravindra_single_cells_processed/cell_annotations_with_umap.tsv) added as metadata.

Cell metadata used:

  • CHIKV objects (from the GEO objects): timepoint (6hpi, 24hpi), chikrnalvl (viral-RNA level category: mock, no_chikv, low_chikv, high_chikv), and the viral genes CHIKV-nsp (non-structural) and CHIKV-sp (structural) as features, plus host IFNB1.
  • Ravindra object: scv2+ (1 = SARS-CoV-2-positive cell), ctype (cell type), percent.mt (recomputed below for QC), and host IFNL1.

The Ileum organoid data loaded at the top of the original Ravindra script (/home/bq_cramirez/sds-hd/sd21e005/cramirez/organoids/data/COVID19_July.rda) is not used by this panel (it only feeds a different figure, rigi_vs_stat_signatures.pdf), and is not loaded here.

Loading signatures

As in the original scripts, IFNB/IFNL genes are removed from the signatures (they are the read-out we want to compare against) and the list is reordered to stat_only, rigi_only.

signatures <- readRDS(path2signs)
signatures <- lapply(signatures,
                     function(genes){
                             genes[!grepl('IFNB|IFNL', genes)]
})
signatures <- signatures[c(2,1)]
str(signatures)
## List of 2
##  $ stat_only: chr [1:99] "PNPT1" "TRIM5" "CSF1" "ZNF711" ...
##  $ rigi_only: chr [1:94] "EGR4" "CXCL11" "FOSB" "EGR2" ...

Panel: CHIKV-infected fibroblasts (plots_chikv.pdf)

Loading the CHIKV 6 hpi data

The original script decompressed the .rds.gz GEO file next to the data (the gunzip() call, commented out). The decompressed file already exists in the data folder, so we read it directly and never write there.

path2chikv6hpi <- "/media/bq-storage/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/data/GSE176361_chkv_2021/GSE176361_integrated_6hpi.rds.gz"
#gunzip(
#  path2chikv6hpi,
#  destname = sub("\\.gz$", "", path2chikv6hpi),
#  overwrite = FALSE
#)
path_rds <- sub("\\.gz$", "", path2chikv6hpi)
obj_chikv6hpi <- readRDS(path_rds)
obj_chikv6hpi
## An object of class Seurat 
## 53910 features across 47041 samples within 3 assays 
## Active assay: SCT (23781 features, 0 variable features)
##  3 layers present: counts, data, scale.data
##  2 other assays present: RNA, integrated
##  2 dimensional reductions calculated: pca, umap

Scoring the cells (6 hpi)

Signature genes are restricted to those present in the SCT assay of the 6 hpi object; the same gene lists are used for 24 hpi. Module scores are computed fresh here (the GEO object does not contain these scores).

# Make sure the genes are present in the assay
stat_genes <- intersect(signatures$stat_only, rownames(obj_chikv6hpi[["SCT"]]))
rigi_genes <- intersect(signatures$rigi_only, rownames(obj_chikv6hpi[["SCT"]]))

obj_chikv6hpi <- AddModuleScore(
    object = obj_chikv6hpi,
    features = list(stat_genes, rigi_genes),
    assay = "SCT",
    name = c("STAT_only", "RIGI_only")
)

Loading and scoring the CHIKV 24 hpi data

path2chikv24hpi <- "/media/bq-storage/ag-cherrmann/cramirez/data/GSE176361_chkv_2021/GSE176361_integrated_24hpi.rds.gz"
#gunzip(
#  path2chikv24hpi,
#  destname = sub("\\.gz$", "", path2chikv24hpi),
#  overwrite = FALSE
#)
path_rds <- sub("\\.gz$", "", path2chikv24hpi)
obj_chikv24hpi <- readRDS(path_rds)

obj_chikv24hpi <- AddModuleScore(
    object = obj_chikv24hpi,
    features = list(stat_genes, rigi_genes),
    assay = "SCT",
    name = c("STAT_only", "RIGI_only")
)

Combining the scores of both time points

The per-cell scores, viral-RNA category, CHIKV-nsp and IFNB1 expression of both time points are combined and saved to analysis/supplementary_figure_02/.

scores <- rbind(
            FetchData(obj_chikv6hpi,
                      vars = c("chikrnalvl", "timepoint",
                               "STAT_only1", "RIGI_only2",
                               "CHIKV-nsp", "IFNB1")),
            FetchData(obj_chikv24hpi,
                      vars = c("chikrnalvl", "timepoint",
                               "STAT_only1", "RIGI_only2",
                               "CHIKV-nsp", "IFNB1"))
)

saveRDS(scores, file.path(path2analysis, "chikv_cell_scores.rds"))

rm(obj_chikv6hpi, obj_chikv24hpi); invisible(gc())

Scatter plot (top of plots_chikv.pdf)

RIG-I-only vs STAT-only scores coloured by viral-RNA category; high_chikv cells are excluded. The colour vector chikrnalvl_cols is defined here (in the original script it was defined in a later chunk, i.e. the PDF was produced from an interactive session with the colours already in memory).

chikrnalvl_cols <- c(
  "mock"      = "#4C78A8",  # blue
  "no_chikv"  = "#9E9E9E",  # gray
  "low_chikv" = "#F58518"   # orange
)

scatterplot_chikv <- scores %>%
        mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint,
                                levels = c("6hpi", "24hpi"))
               ) %>%
        filter(chikrnalvl != "high_chikv") %>%
        arrange(chikrnalvl) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x=RIGI_only2,
                   y=STAT_only1,
                   colour=chikrnalvl)) +
                geom_point(alpha=0.35,
                           size=1.5) +
                geom_vline(xintercept = 0.15,
                           colour="black",
                           linetype="dashed") +
                facet_wrap(~timepoint) +
                        theme_bw() +
                scale_colour_manual(values = chikrnalvl_cols)

scatterplot_chikv

Boxplots of RIG-I-high cells (bottom of plots_chikv.pdf)

Cells with RIG-I-only score > 0.15 are called RIG-I-high. For these cells we compare IFNB1 expression and log CHIKV-nsp expression across viral-RNA categories (Kruskal-Wallis test per time point).

scores <- mutate(scores,
                 rigi_level=ifelse(RIGI_only2>0.15,
                        "High", "Low"))

boxplot_chikv <- scores %>%
    mutate(
        timepoint = factor(timepoint,
                           levels = c("6hpi", "24hpi"))
    ) %>%
    filter(
        rigi_level == "High",
        chikrnalvl != "high_chikv"
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = timepoint,
               y = log(`CHIKV-nsp`),
               fill = chikrnalvl)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    stat_compare_means(
        method = "kruskal.test",
        label = "p.format"
    ) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = chikrnalvl_cols) +
    labs(
        x = "",
        y = "CHIKV-nsp gene expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic()


boxplot_ifnb1 <- scores %>%
    mutate(
        timepoint = factor(timepoint,
                           levels = c("6hpi", "24hpi"))
    ) %>%
    filter(
        rigi_level == "High",
        chikrnalvl != "high_chikv"
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = timepoint,
               y = IFNB1,
               fill = chikrnalvl)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = chikrnalvl_cols) +
    stat_compare_means(
        method = "kruskal.test",
        label = "p.format"
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "",
        y = "IFNB1 gene expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic()

Saving plots_chikv.pdf

scatterplot_chikv / ( boxplot_ifnb1 |  boxplot_chikv )

pdf(paste0(path2figures, "/plots_chikv.pdf"),
    height=6.0, width=7.5)
scatterplot_chikv / ( boxplot_ifnb1 |  boxplot_chikv )
dev.off()

Panel: SARS-CoV-2-infected HBECs, Ravindra et al. (scatterplot_rigi_vs_stat_ravindra.pdf)

Loading data

seurat <- readRDS(file = paste0(path2project,
                   '/data/ravindra_single_cells_processed/ravindra_processed_seurat.rds'))
seurat
## An object of class Seurat 
## 23602 features across 76930 samples within 1 assay 
## Active assay: RNA (23602 features, 0 variable features)
##  4 layers present: counts.GSM5082289_mock, counts.GSM5082290_1dpi, counts.GSM5082291_2dpi, counts.GSM5082292_3dpi

Pre-processing

Cells with > 20% mitochondrial reads are removed and the counts are log-normalised (NormalizeData), which is what AddModuleScore and FetchData(..., "IFNL1") use (data layer).

seurat[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat,
                                                 pattern = "^MT-")

# QC filtering
seurat_filtered <- subset(seurat, percent.mt < 20)

# Normalization
seurat_filtered <- NormalizeData(seurat_filtered)

rm(seurat); invisible(gc())

The original script additionally ran FindVariableFeatures() and ScaleData(). Neither the module scores (computed on the data layer) nor the plotted IFNL1 values depend on them, so they are kept here for reference but not evaluated (eval=FALSE).

# Find variable features
seurat_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_filtered,
                                 selection.method = "vst",
                                 nfeatures = 5000)

# Scaling
seurat_filtered <- ScaleData(seurat_filtered,
                             features = c(VariableFeatures(seurat_filtered),
                                          "IFNB1"))

Scoring Ravindra cells

seurat_filtered <- AddModuleScore(
  object = seurat_filtered,
  features = signatures,
  name = names(signatures)
)

Scatter plot of infected cells (scatterplot_rigi_vs_stat_ravindra.pdf)

RIG-I-only (rigi_only2) vs STAT-only (stat_only1) scores of SARS-CoV-2-positive cells, coloured by IFNL1 expression and faceted by cell type. The per-cell table is saved to analysis/supplementary_figure_02/.

md_ravindra <- FetchData(seurat_filtered,
                         vars = colnames(seurat_filtered@meta.data))


markers_df <- FetchData(seurat_filtered, vars = 'IFNL1')
md_ravindra_subset <- md_ravindra[rownames(markers_df),]

all(rownames(md_ravindra_subset) == rownames(markers_df))
## [1] TRUE
md_ravindra_subset <- cbind(md_ravindra_subset, markers_df)

saveRDS(md_ravindra_subset[, c("sample", "ctype", "scv2+", "percent.mt",
                               "stat_only1", "rigi_only2", "IFNL1")],
        file.path(path2analysis, "ravindra_cell_scores.rds"))

projection_ravindra <- md_ravindra_subset %>%
        arrange(IFNL1) %>%
  mutate(
    Infection_status = ifelse(`scv2+` == 1, "Infected", "Non-Infected")
  ) %>%
        filter(Infection_status == 'Infected') %>%
        dplyr::arrange(desc(Infection_status)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = rigi_only2,
    y = stat_only1,
    color = IFNL1
  )) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_point() +
        scale_colour_viridis() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "RIG-I–only score",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "STAT-only score",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ ctype) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )


pdf(paste0(path2figures,
           "/scatterplot_rigi_vs_stat_ravindra.pdf"),
    width=7, height=5)
projection_ravindra
dev.off()
